g.text: Corroborated = dialysis claim graded strong or moderate (derived/v1/grades.parquet) and confirmed on the facility's own website (kb/web_evidence/out/web_service_summary.parquet): 408 units in 166 districts.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Population: WorldPop 2025 1 km (CC BY 4.0, doi:10.5258/SOTON/WP00840) in 5 km blocks; districts: LGD polygons used for aggregation only, not drawn. Road km: geo.travel estimate (straight line x measured road factor,

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: about 1.3; at the 10th to 90th percentile factor 1.14 to 2.01 each value would be roughly 0.88 to 1.55 times as large; island districts have no road link, are left off the map and are flagged in the CSV). Map:

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: points only, no boundaries. The government counts 1,994 public centres in 751 districts (NHSRC PMNDP); most are not in the facility records (external/pmndp_counts_and_state_lists/README.md).
